description: Two switches under one control: one input sent to either of two outputs, and either of two inputs sent to one output, each polyphonic channel switched on its own

params.text: Toggles both switch sections between the red position and the green position; with a cable in the CV input it has no effect

inputs.text: Sets both switch sections, red below 0.1V and green above 2V; a polyphonic cable here switches each channel of the switched signals by the matching CV channel
The signal fed into the one-into-two section, sent to one of that section's two outputs while the other is held at 0V
Passed to the two-into-one section's output while the red position is chosen
Passed to the two-into-one section's output while the green position is chosen

outputs.text: Carries the one-into-two section's input while the red position is chosen, and 0V while green is chosen
Carries the one-into-two section's input while the green position is chosen, and 0V while red is chosen
Carries whichever of the two-into-one section's inputs is chosen, and stays at 0V unless both of those inputs have cables

notes: the SELECTION array shows the position picked for each of the sixteen channels, red for the first and green for the second
